body_lead: Is This Really A Government School In Assam? People Can’t Believe Their Eyes: ‘Mujhe Toh AI Lag Raha Hai’ A video tour of a newly renovated government school has left viewers impressed by its modern facilities. A short video showing the inside of a government school has caught the attention of many online. What looks like a modern private campus turns out to be a newly upgraded public school, leaving people surprised. The clip walks through the building and its facilities, highlighting how far government schools have come.
